title: FLOOR THIRTEEN
hook: the building has twelve|the lift has thirteen
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail

music.tags: quiet tense strings, low pulse, anticipation, restrained orchestral, instrumental

beats.prompt: An old civic building lobby with terrazzo floors and brass fittings, wide shot, cold daylight, empty
beats.motion: Light shifts slowly across the floor.
beats.caption: Twelve floors. Count the windows.

line.text: This building has twelve floors. The plans say twelve. The windows count to twelve.

beats.prompt: Close-up of an old brass lift panel with numbered buttons, hard side light, aged metal, high detail
beats.motion: A button lights up on its own.
beats.caption: The lift has thirteen

line.text: The lift has a button for thirteen.

beats.prompt: The inside of an old open lift compartment moving past a floor landing, motion, warm interior light, cinematic
beats.motion: The compartment rises slowly past the landing.
beats.caption: People have pressed it

line.text: It is not a mistake. People have pressed it.

beats.prompt: A dark landing lit by one bulb, seen from inside a rising lift, cinematic, unsettling
beats.motion: The landing slides slowly out of view upward.
